titleEn: Shortest Path to Get All Keys
title: 获取所有钥匙的最短路径
summary: 网格中包含起点、墙、钥匙和对应锁，可四向移动且持有钥匙后才能过锁，求取得全部钥匙的最少步数。
insight: 位置相同但持有钥匙集合不同是不同状态；对 (row,column,keyMask) 做 BFS，首次达到全部钥匙掩码即为最短路径。
pitfalls: 锁在没有对应钥匙时不可进入
拾取钥匙后要更新位掩码
访问集合必须包含钥匙状态

solutions.title: 位置与钥匙掩码 BFS
solutions.idea: 在扩展状态空间中逐层搜索。
steps: 扫描网格找到起点并汇总 targetMask
四向移动：跳墙和无钥匙锁，遇钥匙更新 mask；未访问则入队，mask==target 时返回距离，耗尽返回 -1

code.java: class Solution { public int shortestPathAllKeys(String[] grid){int rows=grid.length,columns=grid[0].length(),startRow=0,startColumn=0,target=0;for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<columns;c++){char value=grid[r].charAt(c);if(value=='@'){startRow=r;startColumn=c;}else if(value>='a'&&value<='f')target|=1<<(value-'a');}boolean[][][] seen=new boolean[rows][columns][64];Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.offer(new int[]{startRow,startColumn,0,0});seen[startRow][startColumn][0]=true;int[] directions={-1,0,1,0,-1};while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] state=queue.poll();if(state[2]==target)return state[3];for(int d=0;d<4;d++){int r=state[0]+directions[d],c=state[1]+directions[d+1];if(r<0||r>=rows||c<0||c>=columns||grid[r].charAt(c)=='#')continue;char value=grid[r].charAt(c);int mask=state[2];if(value>='A'&&value<='F'&&(mask&(1<<(value-'A')))==0)continue;if(value>='a'&&value<='f')mask|=1<<(value-'a');if(!seen[r][c][mask]){seen[r][c][mask]=true;queue.offer(new int[]{r,c,mask,state[3]+1});}}}return -1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun shortestPathAllKeys(grid:Array<String>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val columns=grid[0].length;var startRow=0;var startColumn=0;var target=0;for(r in 0 until rows)for(c in 0 until columns){val value=grid[r][c];if(value=='@'){startRow=r;startColumn=c}else if(value in 'a'..'f')target=target or (1 shl(value-'a'))};val seen=Array(rows){Array(columns){BooleanArray(64)}};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();queue.addLast(intArrayOf(startRow,startColumn,0,0));seen[startRow][startColumn][0]=true;val directions=intArrayOf(-1,0,1,0,-1);while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.removeFirst();if(state[2]==target)return state[3];for(d in 0 until 4){val r=state[0]+directions[d];val c=state[1]+directions[d+1];if(r !in 0 until rows||c !in 0 until columns||grid[r][c]=='#')continue;val value=grid[r][c];var mask=state[2];if(value in 'A'..'F'&&(mask and (1 shl(value-'A')))==0)continue;if(value in 'a'..'f')mask=mask or (1 shl(value-'a'));if(!seen[r][c][mask]){seen[r][c][mask]=true;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(r,c,mask,state[3]+1))}}};return -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int shortestPathAllKeys(vector<string>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),columns=grid[0].size(),startRow=0,startColumn=0,target=0;for(int r=0;r<rows;++r)for(int c=0;c<columns;++c){char value=grid[r][c];if(value=='@'){startRow=r;startColumn=c;}else if(value>='a'&&value<='f')target|=1<<(value-'a');}bool seen[30][30][64]{};queue<array<int,4>> pending;pending.push({startRow,startColumn,0,0});seen[startRow][startColumn][0]=true;int directions[5]={-1,0,1,0,-1};while(!pending.empty()){auto state=pending.front();pending.pop();if(state[2]==target)return state[3];for(int d=0;d<4;++d){int r=state[0]+directions[d],c=state[1]+directions[d+1];if(r<0||r>=rows||c<0||c>=columns||grid[r][c]=='#')continue;char value=grid[r][c];int mask=state[2];if(value>='A'&&value<='F'&&!(mask&(1<<(value-'A'))))continue;if(value>='a'&&value<='f')mask|=1<<(value-'a');if(!seen[r][c][mask]){seen[r][c][mask]=true;pending.push({r,c,mask,state[3]+1});}}}return -1;} };
